title: check.py does not resolve DECISION tags in CSV data rows
goal: check.py resolves every [DECISION <id>] tag in a root's CSV data rows as it does in Markdown, and reports an unknown id, with a test named decision_tag that plants one.

run: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); git clone -q "$PWD" "$d/r"; cd "$d/r"; python3 -c 'import csv,io;p='"'"'kb/public/auth/flows.csv'"'"';L=open(p,encoding='"'"'utf-8'"'"').read().split(chr(10));r=next(csv.reader([L[1]]));r[-1]+='"'"' [DECISION D-zzzzzzzz]'"'"';b=io.StringIO();csv.writer(b,lineterminator='"'"''"'"').writerow(r);L[1]=b.getvalue();open(p,'"'"'w'"'"',encoding='"'"'utf-8'"'"',newline='"'"''"'"').write(chr(10).join(L))'; if python3 _tools/check.py >/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
